newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds close firmer but tradeless again.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds close firmer but tradeless again.

text.p: LONDON, April 3 - UK meals and feeds closed firmer following fresh gains on the Chicago soybean meal futures, but with traders once again sidelined awaiting fresh developments from the US.
"The trouble is that apart from the soybean meal sector there isn't any real interest in doing any business, and for significant trade to occur, prices have got to fall in Chicago," one trader said.
Soybean meal selling levels posted gains of one sterling per tonne, while the rest of the market was unchanged.
